title: Depth order of checkpoint A on PHerc0343P with identical tiling, on our support (N) and on EconLearn's rebuilt support (E)
frozen_before: any phase 18 download of layers, infrared photo or ink labels, and any phase 18 inference
not_blind: EconLearn's ROC-AUCs (0.599 stored order at stride 256, 0.936 reversed at stride 128) and his selection rules were known when this protocol was written.

training_list_check.result: No identifier names PHerc0343P (no '0343', '343p', '343_' or 'PHerc'). The only '343' substring is inside the timestamp 'auto_grown_20250918234353791'. Several identifiers are opaque ('-1', '658', 'l_2' ... 'w00'), so absence from training is probable, not attested.
training_list_check.consequence: Report the phase as exploratory with probable, not attested, independence.

fragment.name: PHerc0343P
fragment.canvas_um_reason: EconLearn's factor 0.2564 to his 8.64 um grid gives 8.64 x 0.2564 = 2.215 um, the resolution of checkpoint A's recipe; '2um' in the path is rounded. Stop if the package metadata says otherwise.
fragment.licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://dl.ash2txt.org/fragments/PHerc0343P/LICENSE.txt). Infrared photo, registration and tracing by the Vesuvius Challenge team. Only aggregate statistics are published.

count_check_fragment.name: PHerc0500P2
count_check_fragment.use: Support E count search only (no layer, no inference, no score).

orders.Z_out: planes in descending layer number (63 -> 02, or 62 -> 01): papyrus -> air, by the phase 17 texture rule (air at layers 02-14, r = 5.83)
orders.Z_in: planes in ascending layer number (02 -> 63, or 01 -> 62)

inputs.intensity: uint8 PNG as published, then the phase 6 rule: min(x, 200) / 200 (prepare_tile). No W2 window, no resampling.
inputs.padding: The canvas is padded with zeros at the bottom and right to a multiple of 256 px so that both strides tile it exactly.
inputs.tiles_run: A tile is run when it contains at least one pixel of the published mask (alpha > 0, phase 17 load_mask rule). Other tiles stay empty (weight 0, score NaN).
inputs.blend: Hann window hanning(258)[1:-1] outer product, accumulated score x weight divided by accumulated weight (phase 11).
inputs.weights: r152_3ddec_v2_l5_epoch13.ckpt, SHA-256 checked by the phase 6 constants, weights_only=True, FP32, deterministic cuDNN, TF32 off (phase 11 run code).
inputs.baselines: B1 and B2 exactly as phase13_eval.baselines, on the window 02-63 stack in Z_out order (planes 30-31 and 26-35, i.e. layers 33-32 and 37-28), computed in row strips with a 32 px halo.
inputs.determinism: The central run tile of each map is inferred again at the end of the run; the maximum absolute difference is reported.

support_N.valid: phase 11 rule: published mask eroded by 16 px (scipy binary_erosion, default cross, iterations=16), Hann weight of Z_out_s128 >= 25 % of its maximum, and Z_out_s128, Z_in_s128, B1, B2 all finite.
support_N.positives: valid pixels whose ink label is > 127 after conversion to 8-bit grey.
support_N.negatives: valid pixels with label <= 127 whose Euclidean distance to the nearest positive label pixel exceeds the tolerance (301 um = 135.9 px). The ring between 0 and the tolerance is excluded from both classes.
support_N.inclusion: A ROI enters the pooled N metrics if it has at least 1000 positives and 1000 negatives (MIN_CLASS) at the 301 um tolerance; excluded ROIs are counted and reported.

support_E.source: EconLearn, villa#2627, 25 November 2026: truth on a grid 0.2564 x the canvas (8.64 um per pixel); ink = traced letters shrunk by 2 px; negatives ('photo-clean') = pixels at least 12 px from any traced letter where the infrared photo is brighter than its median over the fragment; region = fragment mask shrunk by 10 px where the tiles produced a value; AUC after quantising the map to 256 levels between its 0.1 and 99.9 percentiles.

interpretations.order: itertools.product over the keys in this order; the index of a combination is its position in that product (0-based).

definitions.grid_size: (H_g, W_g) = round or floor of 0.2564 x (H, W). Cell i spans canvas rows floor(i H / H_g) to floor((i+1) H / H_g).
definitions.nearest: the canvas pixel that contains the cell centre: floor((i + 0.5) H / H_g), clipped.
definitions.area_half: cell mean of the binary image >= 0.5.
definitions.infrared_luma: grey images as is; RGB(A) as 0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B in float; 16-bit as float.
definitions.erosion: shrunk by r px = keep pixels whose inside distance to the background (pixels outside the image count as background) is > r, in the chosen metric. Euclidean = distance_transform_edt; taxicab and chessboard = distance_transform_cdt (equal to r iterations of binary_erosion with the cross and the 3x3 square).
definitions.distance_to_letters: distance from a non-letter pixel to the nearest letter pixel in the chosen metric (outside the image is not a letter); 'at least 12 px' = distance >= 12.
definitions.morphology_grid_grid: letters and mask are reduced to the grid first; radii 2, 12, 10 grid px.
definitions.morphology_grid_canvas: morphology on the canvas with radii 2 / 0.2564, 12 / 0.2564 and 10 / 0.2564 canvas px; the binary results are then reduced with the chosen label reduction.
definitions.covered: grid cells whose canvas area is entirely inside run tiles at stride 128 (tile rule above, computed from the mask alone).
definitions.median: median of the reduced infrared luma over the chosen population: region; mask = reduced, uneroded mask; region_non_ink = region minus reduced uneroded letters.
definitions.clean: region AND distance to letters >= 12 AND infrared luma > median.

support_E.selection: For each combination compute the five counts (PHerc0343P ink, clean, valid; PHerc0500P2 ink, clean) and their maximal relative error to the published counts. Keep the combination with the smallest error; ties go to the lower index.
support_E.otherwise: Support E is 'approximate' and every E result is descriptive only.
support_E.published_in: phase18-supports.json holds the counts and errors of all 216 combinations, written before any ROC-AUC.
support_E.score_reduction: area mean of the finite canvas scores in the cell; a cell with less than 50 % finite pixels is NaN. Sensitivity: nearest canvas pixel.
support_E.evaluated_cells: ink or clean cells where every compared score is finite.
support_E.quantisation: per map, 256 levels: clip(floor((x - p0.1) / (p99.9 - p0.1) x 256), 0, 255), percentiles over the region cells with finite scores. Sensitivity: raw scores in 4096 bins on [0, 1].
support_E.without_infrared_filter: sensitivity: clean = region AND distance to letters >= 12 AND not ink (no infrared condition).

hypotheses.per_support: Each hypothesis is tested separately on N (raw scores, tolerance 301 um) and on E (quantised scores); one verdict per support. On E the verdict is confirmatory only if E is reconstructed.
hypotheses.H1: ROC-AUC(Z_out_s128) - ROC-AUC(Z_in_s128) > 0: lower bound of the 95 % interval above 0.
hypotheses.H2: ROC-AUC(Z_out_s128) > 0.5: lower bound of the 95 % interval above 0.5.
hypotheses.H3: ROC-AUC(Z_out_s128) - max(ROC-AUC(B1), ROC-AUC(B2)) > 0, the maximum taken per draw: lower bound above 0.
hypotheses.also_reported: PR-AUC (average precision) and prevalence for every score.

uncertainty.primary: Paired bootstrap over ink connected components (8-connectivity), phase 15 recommendation. Every evaluated positive belongs to its component; every evaluated negative is attached to the nearest component (Euclidean, on the evaluation grid; for N computed on 4 x 4 canvas blocks, each block taking the largest component label it contains, then broadcast back). Each draw resamples components with replacement; the same draws serve every score. 1999 draws, seed 218, percentile 95 % interval.
secondary: ROI bootstrap (N: the 2048 px ROIs; E: the ROI of each cell centre), 1999 draws, seed 219
64 x 64 px block bootstrap on each support's own grid, 1999 draws, seed 220, known to be optimistic

tiling_effect: Descriptive, on E (quantised) and on N: ROC-AUC of Z_out_s128, Z_in_s128, Z_out_s256, Z_in_s256; order effect at each stride and stride effect at each order, each with its component-bootstrap interval.

placement_test.support: E (selected combination), quantised Z_out_s128 and Z_in_s128
placement_test.rule: 2000 cyclic rolls of the reduced uneroded letters and of their distance map by (dy, dx) drawn uniformly on the grid, seed 1802, redrawn while sqrt(dy^2 + dx^2) < 64 grid px. Ink = rolled eroded letters AND region; clean = region AND rolled distance >= 12 AND infrared luma > median (same median as the selected combination) AND not rolled ink.
placement_test.reported: the rank of the true placement among the 2000, the maximum and the 99th percentile of the rolled ROC-AUCs, compared with EconLearn's best random 0.722.

comparison_with_EconLearn: Descriptive only: our E ROC-AUC of Z_out_s128 against 0.936 and of Z_in_s256 against 0.599. Supports, rounding and seeds may differ; a gap proves no error on either side.
secondary_window: Window 01-62 maps on N and E: estimates and the order difference with its component interval, no decision.
steps: 1. Commit this protocol, phase18_eval.py and tests/test_phase18.py. No phase 18 download.

2. --prepare (layers 01-63 and mask only, SHA-256 of each file), --run on CUDA, --baselines, --hash: commit phase18-prepare.json and phase18-scores.json (SHA-256 of every map, label-free statistics). Maps stay outside Git. Commit message: cartes de scores hachées avant ouverture des étiquettes.

3. --supports: download the PHerc0343P infrared and labels and the three PHerc0500P2 files, record SHA-256, write phase18-supports.json (N counts, all 216 E combinations, selection). No ROC-AUC. Refuses to run before phase18-scores.json exists and matches the maps.
4. --report: phase18-eval.json. Refuses any map whose SHA-256 differs from phase18-scores.json.
5. Report PHASE18_REPRODUCTION_343P.md, handoff, PR description, draft follow-up.
optional_step_C: PHerc0500P2 (in A's training list as 500p2a): the same maps and supports, descriptive only, no hypothesis. Run only if the measured PHerc0343P GPU time projects to at most 6 h for PHerc0500P2; otherwise the PO decides.
frozen_rules: No threshold, radius, tolerance, bin count, seed, draw count, ROI size, MIN_CLASS or selection rule changes after the labels are opened. A rule that proves inapplicable is reported as such.
